R-099.claim: The data-centre pipeline (capacity in contracting stages, over 54 GW) grew by over 6 GW (13%) since end-2025, per the CFO on the Q3 call
R-099.quote_or_locator: Steven D. Ridge: 'We now have over 54 gigawatts of data center capacity in various stages of contracting' ... 'we have added over 6 gigawatts of contracts or 13% since the end of last year.' [I] The 13% fits the 54 GW pipeline (6/0.13 = 46 GW base), not the 12 GW under electric service agreements.
